address: 306 Chateau Dale Complex 64-68 Thappraya Road, Pattaya, Nong Prue, Bang Lamung, Chon Buri, 20150, Thailand
bio: This fine dining spot delivers authentic Indian cuisine in an inviting ambiance featuring contemporary Indian paintings and decorative touches. With creative twists on North Indian staples, highlights include chicken tikka and dal makhni. Main dishes are thoughtfully served in small pots over a flame to keep them warm. For solo diners, the traditional thali sets comprise tasty samples of signature à la carte dishes....
